-- BloodArena Server Script
-- Sets up a simple arena where hazards cause damage and players earn points.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Create a RemoteEvent for damage feedback to clients
local damageEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
damageEvent.Name = "DamageEvent"
damageEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

-- Function to apply damage to a player's character
local function applyDamage(player, amount)
    local character = player.Character
    if character then
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then
            humanoid:TakeDamage(amount)
        end
    end
end

-- Function to handle a hazard touch event
local function onHazardTouched(hazard, otherPart)
    local character = otherPart.Parent
    local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
    if player then
        applyDamage(player, 10) -- Damage amount
        damageEvent:FireClient(player, "You were injured!")
    end
end

-- Create the arena structure
local arena = Instance.new("Model")
arena.Name = "BloodArena"
arena.Parent = Workspace

-- Floor
local floor = Instance.new("Part")
floor.Name = "Floor"
floor.Size = Vector3.new(100, 1, 100)
floor.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
floor.Anchored = true
floor.CanCollide = true
floor.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Really red")
floor.Parent = arena

-- Hazard template (spikes)
local spikeTemplate = Instance.new("Part")
spikeTemplate.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)
spikeTemplate.Shape = Enum.PartType.Block
spikeTemplate.CanCollide = true
spikeTemplate.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Dark gray")
spikeTemplate.Transparency = 0.5
spikeTemplate.Name = "Spike"

-- Function to place a hazard at given coordinates
local function placeSpike(x, y, z)
    local spike = spikeTemplate:Clone()
    spike.Position = Vector3.new(x, 1, z)
    spike.Parent = arena
    spike.Touched:Connect(function(part)
        onHazardTouched(spike, part)
    end)
end

-- Populate arena with spikes
for i = 1, 10 do
    placeSpike(math.random(-40, 40), 1, math.random(-40, 40))
end

-- Track player scores
local scores = {}

-- Give points to surviving players after 30 seconds
local startTime = tick()
local scoreConnection
scoreConnection = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    local elapsed = tick() - startTime
    if elapsed > 30 then
        scoreConnection:Disconnect()
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").Health > 0 then
                scores[player] = (scores[player] or 0) + 100
                player.leaderstats.Points.Value = scores[player] or 0
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- Initialize leaderstats for each player
local function setupLeaderstats(player)
    local stats = Instance.new("Folder")
    stats.Name = "leaderstats"
    stats.Parent = player

    local points = Instance.new("IntValue")
    points.Name = "Points"
    points.Value = 0
    points.Parent = stats
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setupLeaderstats)

-- Clean up when the script ends or place shuts down
game:BindToClose(function()
    scoreConnection:Disconnect()
end)
